description: Historical Peak Demand is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Historical Peak Demand dataset provides information on substation peak demand seen in an annual year, back to 2019/2020. This information is provided for substations on the Northern Powergrid EHV network. We have also included percentage growth columns to show the change of max demand between years. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network, Connecting Demand. Its keywords are Demand, Extra High Voltage (EHV), EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2025-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
